object.attr: derived: failure analysis CF-G37 (D-G19). Two lists of a document's files can drift, and a change the loader sees but the check doesn't is never flagged. MELLON-GUI-SRS-99 then holds only if loading skips side files.
object.description: The Document Editor shall count as a change on disk a change to each file that Mellon reads to load the document or a parent document.
